Subject: Identity stack contract extension & device-posture add-on — pricing + next steps

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the heads-up on the upcoming renewal window. We want to align on a one-year extension for our core SSO/MFA seats and add the device-posture module for an initial rollout across our US org (approx. 1,200 active users initially, scaling to ~2,500 by end of year).

Can you send: 
- A pricing grid with seat tiers and the device-posture add-on broken out (seat counts we currently have + uplift tiers).
- Any SKUs or licensing constraints for conditional access policies tied to device posture.
- SOC2/attestation evidence and any change to data residency or log retention that would affect our compliance posture.

We'd like to schedule a 30-min sync next week to review the numbers and confirm a start date (targeting 2026-07-01 activation). For context I'm looping in Hiro (security) and Lauren (legal) — Marissa is on procurement.

High level asks for the meeting:
- Final price table and discount thresholds
- Implementation timeline for posture rollout and any professional services needed
- Contract length options (12 vs 24 months) and early-termination/rollback terms

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@okta.com>

Cc: Okta Renewals <renewals@okta.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Identity stack contract extension & device-posture add-on — pricing + next steps

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear outline. Attaching a pricing grid (okta_pricing_grid_v3.xlsx) and a short one-pager on device posture capabilities. Highlights:

- 12-month extension: list price $0.45/user/mo for SSO+MFA; device posture add-on $0.20/user/mo.
- Volume discount tiers: 5% @ 1k+, 10% @ 2.5k+, 15% @ 5k+.
- Professional services for posture rollout (optional): estimated 8-12 days (IdentityWorks preferred partner).

We do not require any change to log residency for the add-on; SOC2 report is available on request (we can share the attestation PDF via secure link).

Proposed next step: 30-min call Mon 6/1 or Tue 6/2. I can also prep a draft SOW and PO instructions if you want to speed things up.

--
Sarah Liu
Enterprise Renewals, Okta
sarah.liu@okta.com
